hero.title: Information Technology in the USA
hero.subtitle: The United States is a popular destination for students pursuing Information Technology (IT) because of its technology-driven economy, internationally recognized universities, and wide range of academic programs.

highlights.degree: B.S. / M.S. in Information Technology & Systems
highlights.eligibility: Class 12 (UG) / Bachelor's in IT, CS or Engineering (MS)

overview: Information Technology education combines technical knowledge with practical skills in computer systems, networking, databases, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, and enterprise technology management.

faq.question: Can Indian students pursue Information Technology studies in the United States following Class 12 completion?
faq.answer: Yes, Indian students are eligible to apply for undergraduate programs in Information Technology-related disciplines upon completion of Class 12.

faq.question: What is the typical duration for completing an Information Technology degree program in the United States?
faq.answer: Bachelor's degree programs generally require four years of study, whereas master's degree programs typically necessitate one to two years of enrollment.
